failures.SYMPTOM: Drawing Engine existed but Hannam production used separate Python/HTML/ReportLab paths
failures.USER_OBSERVED: User repeatedly asked why the engine was not used
failures.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: All production artifacts route through authorized Drawing Engine
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Local one-off executors could create user-facing artifacts
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: Execution authority was attached to task completion, not to a mandatory router; engine availability was advisory rather than exclusive
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: No pre-production route authorization gate; package validator checked structure only
failures.MISSING_ENFORCEMENT: PRODUCTION_RESULT capability owned only by router
failures.SOURCE_IMPACT: Engine consistency lost; duplicate logic and drift
failures.QUALITY_IMPACT: Uncontrolled quality and inconsistent renderer behavior
failures.REGRESSION_TEST: Block direct production plan; router allowlist; diagnostic-only one-off scripts

failures.SYMPTOM: Rectangular raster masking removed wall/core/entry while removing furniture
failures.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Protected geometry remains immutable under presentation edits
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Mask operation had destructive pixel authority over architectural linework
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: Raster presentation layer outranked geometry authority and lacked protected-geometry diff before exposure
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: No geometry diff/protected-element gate before show
failures.REGRESSION_TEST: geometry_diff=0 plus wall/core/entry presence required before exposure

failures.USER_OBSERVED: User had to reject regenerated plan
failures.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: AI may enhance atmosphere only; source geometry is final authority
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Generated image became de facto plan image
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: AI layer was permitted to synthesize geometry because source overlay was a convention, not production gate
failures.MISSING_ENFORCEMENT: AI output cannot satisfy GEOMETRY_GATE unless source geometry fingerprint/diff passes
failures.REGRESSION_TEST: AI output subordinate to L1; nonzero geometry diff blocks exposure

failures.SYMPTOM: Large reference library produced generic layouts
failures.USER_OBSERVED: User questioned whether references were actually used
failures.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Reference DNA visibly changes output while preserving source
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Reference names/prose did not compile to lineweight/grid/whitespace/diagram parameters
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: Reference mining ended at descriptive knowledge; no compiler/trace to engine parameter
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Reference validation checked presence, not causal output effect
failures.BYPASS_PATH: Reference prose -> manual interpretation -> generic renderer defaults
failures.REGRESSION_TEST: Machine-readable reference compiler + visible effect gate

failures.SYMPTOM: Source-preserved output was treated as presentation enhancement
failures.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Fidelity and presentation quality independently pass
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Geometry preservation was used as proxy for overall success
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: Quality model collapsed correctness and design effectiveness
failures.MISSING_ENFORCEMENT: Separate fidelity, readability, reference and user-effect gates
failures.REGRESSION_TEST: Independent quality gates; reference effect must be visible without explanation

failures.SYMPTOM: User found deleted geometry, wrong boxes/rotation/crops and weak outputs
failures.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Human approves choices, not mechanical defects
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Results were exposed before deterministic checks
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: User exposure had no hard gate; HUMAN APPROVAL conflated with QA
failures.BYPASS_PATH: Build -> partial check -> show -> user debug
failures.MISSING_ENFORCEMENT: L8 exposure gate; NO PASS -> NO SHOW

failures.SYMPTOM: One-off ReportLab/Python/HTML accumulated around single results
failures.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Recurring capability improvements land in central engine
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Fast local completion had lower friction than central engine change
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: Work OS productive routing lacked exclusive production ownership
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: No rule converting repeated workaround into governance failure
failures.MISSING_ENFORCEMENT: One-off executor cannot produce production/user-facing artifact

failures.SYMPTOM: Later modified timestamp risked marking content-identical PDF stale
failures.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Freshness reflects content/revision evidence, not date alone
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: mtime was used as content-change proxy
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: Freshness model lacked content identity/delta distinction
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Source selection gate lacked hash/semantic delta requirement
failures.REGRESSION_TEST: DATE != CONTENT CHANGE governance + future content-fingerprint check

failures.SYMPTOM: ROAD/SOIL/GROUND inferred from color/topology before verification
failures.USER_OBSERVED: User warned semantics were being guessed
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: L2 semantic authority was not a hard prerequisite for L3 presentation
failures.MISSING_ENFORCEMENT: SEMANTIC_GATE must PASS; unknown stays unknown

failures.SYMPTOM: Narrative risked claims such as perfect privacy/daylight/south-facing/penthouse
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Language generation was downstream of design intent rather than evidence-state contracts
failures.ROOT_CAUSE: Fact gate applied to numbers more strongly than descriptive claims
failures.WHY_EXISTING_GATE_FAILED: Unsupported narrative list was not mandatory pre-user check
failures.MISSING_ENFORCEMENT: Narrative evidence gate integrated into FACT_GATE

failures.EXPECTED_BEHAVIOR: Resume mode must distinguish valid continuation from structural repair
failures.ACTUAL_BEHAVIOR: Handoff optimized continuity without retrospective mode
